notes: Canonical AI goal-prompt formula lines. Android GoalFormulaReference and PWA chompass-core/goal-formula-reference.js must match. Refresh when PAL / protein g/kg / KCAL_PER_KG_BODY_MASS change. 1.1 adds measuredLeanMassBasisLine (scale composition).
activityMultipliersLine: sedentary 1.2, light 1.375, moderate 1.465, active 1.55, very_active 1.725, extra_active 1.9
proteinPerKgLine: sedentary 0.8, light 1.2, moderate 1.6, active 1.8, very_active 2, extra_active 2.2
moderateActivityMultiplierRationale: Moderate uses 1.465 (between FAO/WHO light 1.375 and moderate 1.55) for desk-active users who exercise a few times per week.
calorieSafetyLine: Never set calories below this user's BMR or 1200. If the weekly pace would break that floor, shrink the deficit instead of lowering the floor. 800 kcal is a medically supervised VLCD, not an app target.
proteinLbmCapLine: cap protein at 2.2 g/kg lean mass (2.4 g/kg while losing)
fatTargetLine: at least max(0.6 g/kg bodyweight, 20% of calories)
measuredLeanMassBasisLine: a lean-mass reading from a scale is fresher and more direct than body fat: when it is no older than 90 days and plausible (20-250 kg) it drives Katch-McArdle BMR and the lean-mass protein cap instead of the body-fat estimate
